turnLimitScope: One ACP prompt; cancel/stop on any tool-call or client permission request. Top-level --max-turns is not forwarded to the agent branch in the inspected official source.
prompt:
Review this Windows fixture-preparation design in at most 180 words. No tools or web; use only this metadata.
The production existing-file verifier never repairs ACLs. Its policy requires local fixed NTFS with persistent ACLs; a protected profile-root DACL; owner and allow ACEs limited to current-user SID, SYSTEM, and Administrators; current-user full access from non-inherit-only ACEs. An inherited child is admissible only when bound to its verified containing protected root. Reparse points and extra hard links are refused.
We need independent disposable fixtures, not customer profiles. Proposed preparation: create a new empty directory, independently set a protected explicit DACL for those three principals, with container/object inheritance, before creating fictional files. Verify that prepared ACL independently before invoking production code. Do not repair any existing fixture after invoking the verifier. Negative case: deliberately add a Users-group read ACE before taking before-snapshots, then require refusal and identical bytes/SDDL afterward. No recursive ACL repair outside the disposable root.
Identify whether this separates setup from verify-only behavior, the most important missing assertions, and what must run on actual Windows. Return JSON with keys verdict (string), requiredChecks (array of at most 4 short strings), nativeProofLimit (string). Do not provide scripts or claim success.
authentication: Existing cached auth via opaque symlink in disposable private GROK_HOME; harness never opens auth contents.
